''See also: [[dream tablets Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Dream tablets are specialized devices used to store and transmit complex memories, experiences, and information. While they can be used to record data such as [[sacred arts]] techniques or historical events, they are most effective at capturing the subjective feeling and context of a lived experience. These devices vary in form, appearing as gemstones, polished stones, or large slabs, and are often characterized by a purplish, chaotic [[dream aura]]. Some tablets are highly advanced or composite, containing multiple memories or deep layers of information that can be difficult for certain individuals to process without sufficient spiritual strength. The widespread use of these tablets is attributed to [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] and the [[Path of Ten Thousand Dreams]], which focuses on the sharing of thoughts and memories. This legacy includes the [[Dreamway]], a massive interconnected [[library]] of dream tablets that serves as a source of knowledge and entertainment. In specialized facilities, such as tablet libraries, these devices are organized on shelves to preserve the knowledge of scholars and masters. Some tablets serve as true inheritances, containing a lifetime of expertise intended for a specific successor. Additionally, dream tablets can be used to capture and seal powerful entities like [[Remnants]], providing a way to preserve their essence for long periods.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Dream tablets are scripted river stones roughly the size of a child's fist that have become more common than paper for preserving techniques. These objects were developed and widely adopted after [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] gained the ability to share memories with accuracy. While they are frequently used for inheritances and can depict [[Sages]] performing miraculous abilities, certain information is difficult to preserve. For example, memories regarding advancements to Overlord are notably hard to store within a tablet.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Yerin]] possesses a gem-like [[dream tablets|dream tablet]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|People have experience with [[dream tablets]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[dream tablets|Dream tablets]] depict [[Sages]] using miraculous abilities.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] developed the ability to accurately share memories, leading to the development and widespread adoption of [[dream tablets]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A [[dream tablets|dream tablet]] is a scripted river [[stone]] the size of a child's fist.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[dream tablets|Dream tablets]] are more common than paper for leaving behind techniques.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Memories of advancements to Overlord are hard to store in a [[dream tablets|dream tablet]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Dream tablets are characterized by a chaotic, purplish [[aura]]. These items can appear as small individual pieces or as composite purple-black jewels designed to hold multiple memories. While some tablets are found in specific rooms or discovered by [[Little Blue]] and [[Orthos]], others have been won through high-stakes competitions like the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]]. Notably, [[Lindon]] is in possession of Ozriel’s dream tablets.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Dream tablets are purple-streaked river stones roughly the size of a coin that serve as tools for storing and transmitting thoughts, conclusions, and recollections. These objects can contain memories harvested from an echo within a [[labyrinth]]. Within [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]]' Workshop{{!}}workshop, such tablets were used to record his specific observations. While they are significant for preserving information, a dream tablet is distinct from the greater [[inheritance]] of a [[Soulsmith]].}}
